programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E01
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan explore the history of the woolly mammoth and the saber-toothed cat. Thanks to modern technologies, these huge mammals are brought back to life. Researchers are looking for answers to the question of why animals perfectly adapted to extreme conditions became extinct when the ice began to melt. Michaela discovers a weakness of a prehistoric hunter that may have contributed to his extinction. Meanwhile, Steve learns about a revolutionary gene-editing technique that can revive mammoths. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E02
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. The Ice Age became an arena of struggle between Neanderthals and representatives of Homo sapiens. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan investigate how two competing species have adapted to extreme conditions. Backshall explores southern Germany, where he discovers traces of the life of early humans and their ability to deal with prehistoric predators using advanced tools and weapons. In turn, Strachan examines the differences in anatomy and skills between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. It turns out that despite the physical advantage of the former, the latter showed greater abilities in long-distance running and technological innovation. The key technology that gave them the advantage was the sewing needle, which allowed them to create tighter clothing. The decisive moment that led to the extinction of Neanderthals was global warming and environmental changes that left Homo sapiens as the dominant species. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E03
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. With the melting of ice and global warming, a completely new era in Earth's history begins. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan set out to search for the land that connected Britain with the Old Continent before the end of the Ice Age. Steve goes deep beneath the waves, and Michaela investigates the course of the natural disaster that formed the North Sea and divided Europe. The disaster was a catalyst for the further development of the first people who began to create boats. In the Arctic, Michaela works with the British Antarctic Survey drilling for ice cores. The material obtained in this way will reveal how the world's climate is changing. It turns out that global warming may create ideal conditions for the start of a new ice age. Steve will test whether people would cope if the Earth were plunged into eternal frost again. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: 30 for 30: Long Gone Summer
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: The Last Dance: Episode 1
programme.desc: The Last Dance (Sports). In the fall of 1997, Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls allowed a film crew to follow them as they went for their sixth NBA title in eight seasons. That resulted in a stunning portrait of one of the sport's most iconic athletes and a celebrated team. «The Last Dance» follows the Bulls' 1997-98 season from start to finish, while also covering the rest of the chapters in Jordan's remarkable career. The 10-part docuseries follows the Jordan timeline from when he was an emerging star on his high school team to becoming a worldwide marketing force and cultural figure. The series takes its name from a phrase coined by then-Bulls coach Phil Jackson, who knew that the season would likely be the final run for the core members of that 1990s Bulls dynasty

programme.title: d/f The Challenger tragedy
programme.desc: The film tells us about the space shuttle Challenger and its crew, especially Christa McAuliffe, the first civilian passenger sent into space. McAuliffe was a teacher from Concord, New Hampshire. She was chosen from thousands of applicants to expand students' understanding of space and the next generation of interplanetary travel. But her dreams—and, indeed, NASA's dreams—were tragically shattered when the Challenger exploded in front of television viewers shortly after takeoff. This unique film will show the events of the days leading up to the disaster, without the participation of a narrator and without any interviews with eyewitnesses. The entire film will consist solely of reporting from journalists working on the story, footage taken by the NASA team, and interviews with McAuliffe and others involved in the project. USA, 2016

programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2017. S1, Ep1 «Over Australia»…From the vast, dry plains of the interior come some of Australia's most recognized imagery, such as the monolithic red rock of Uluru and the bounding red kangaroo. But how did the arid centre of the continent come to be? | Australia is the oldest, flattest, driest inhabited continent on Earth. It's a vast landscape, shaped by epic forces that–over 180 million years–have divided it into two worlds: an arid interior covering 70% of the terrain, and a lush haven of mountain ranges spanning the entire eastern coast. Occupying this land of extremes are some of the most unique and resilient creatures on the planet, marsupials, mammals, and insects that have evolved and adapted to thrive inside Australia's arid heart and along its Great Dividing Range | Director: Nick McInerney

programme.title: Extremes of the deep sea – icy abysses
programme.desc: Medusas with ten-meter-long trains, “bloodless” ice fish, sea cucumbers on legs: alien creatures cavort in the deep sea off Antarctica and in the Mariana Trench. Researchers there are on the trail of the secrets of extreme life artists. Why do some creatures grow into giants? How do animals withstand the enormous water pressure at great depths? \n\nAt 8,178 meters below the surface, a Marianas disc swam in front of the film crew's lens - a world record for a vertebrate! And even the lowest point on earth (11,000 m) is alive.

programme.title: Terra X
programme.desc: There are around three million shipwrecks sunk in waters worldwide. They are often the target of looters hoping to make valuable discoveries. They also succumb to decay over time. (Station info).

programme.title: Secrets of the deep sea - In the caves of the coral reefs
programme.desc: “In the cellars of the coral reefs”, at a depth of more than 1000 meters, a Japanese expedition team, accompanied by marine biologist Mark Erdmann, sets out to search for living fossils.

programme.title: Impossible Animals
programme.desc: Fiery heat during the day and sub-zero temperatures at night - deserts are among the most hostile regions on our planet. Nevertheless, incredible survival artists (scorpions) can be found in them, which biologist Patrick Aryee introduces.

programme.title: Impossible Animals
programme.desc: Patrick Aryee pays a visit to the extraordinary inhabitants of the rainforest. The biologist reveals the remarkable adaptability of the local animal world. (Station info).

programme.title: Impossible Animals
programme.desc: Crashing waves and extreme tides - Patrick Aryee studies the amazing animals of the coastal areas. The biologist knows that anyone who wants to survive here needs a lot of ingenuity. (Station info).

programme.title: Africa from above
programme.desc: In South Africa, untamed nature meets vibrant cities. While pods of humpback whales pass by off the coast, children in a township bond over skateboarding. (Station info).

programme.title: Africa from above
programme.desc: Kenya boasts breathtaking flora and fauna. The residents know about their precious treasures and try to protect them from poachers and garbage pollution. (Station info).

programme.title: Africa from above
programme.desc: Ghana also has a lot to offer beyond its fascinating flora and fauna: the country has the most unusual coffins in the world and the first entirely female transport company. (Station info).

programme.title: Africa from above
programme.desc: Ethiopia is shaped by the forces of nature. While a lava lake bubbles in the crater of the Erta Ale volcano, salt workers transport the white gold of the Afar Depression through the surrounding desert. (Station info).

programme.title: Into the Blue – Indonesiens Unterwasserparadiese
programme.desc: Indonesia's spectacular underwater world: In the Blue Corner off Nusa Penida you will not only find huge corals, but also the legendary sunfish - the heaviest bony fish in the world. (Station info).

programme.title: Into the Blue – Indonesiens Unterwasserparadiese
programme.desc: Tropical forests meet warm seas in Triton Bay off New Guinea. Freshwater forms a rare ecosystem with impressive whale sharks and a rich variety of colored soft corals. (Station info).

programme.title: The Tuamotu Islands: natural wonders in the South Seas
programme.desc: The Tuamotu archipelago contains the largest number of coral reefs in the world. The South Pacific archipelago is known for the complex coexistence of a wide variety of animal species. (Station info).

programme.title: Predators of the Carpathians
programme.desc: The Eurasian wolf, which is threatened with extinction, protects the entire ecosystem in the Carpathians. This makes protecting this pack animal with its distinctive sense of smell all the more important. (Station info).

programme.title: The Moon – Mysterious Power of Nature
programme.desc: From the arctic tundra to the tropical oceans: the rhythm of the moon sets the pace for the reproduction of many animal species - including fish, sea turtles and corals. (Station info).

programme.title: Our earth is changing – rivers in need
programme.desc: Pioneering projects for threatened bodies of water: Four dams are being removed in California, the Seine is being cleaned in Paris - experts show how destroyed river landscapes can recover. (Station info).

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Contest of brown bears
programme.desc: An icy storm is making it extremely difficult for bears to find food in Katmai National Park. They only have a short amount of time to gain the 90 kilos they need for hibernation. (Station info).

programme.title: Game of Leopard Thrones – The Queen of the Leopards

programme.title: Nature's prodigies

programme.title: Nature's prodigies

programme.title: ĐIỆP VỤ ĐẢO QUỶ - OPERATION BANGKOK
programme.desc: Cựu quân nhân Wu và cảnh sát chìm Ming giải cứu con tin trên một hòn đảo gần Bangkok. Ngay khi nhiệm vụ hoàn thành và họ chuẩn bị rời đi, Wu phát hiện ra con gái mình cũng đã bị bắt. Quyết tâm cứu cô, anh ở lại cùng Ming để chiến đấu với bọn côn đồ và giải cứu cô.

programme.title: VÕ TÒNG BÁO THÙ - WUSONG VS XIMENQING
programme.desc: Ngô Song phát hiện ra chuyện chị dâu ngoại tình với một người đàn ông giàu có, Tây Môn Khánh. Qing gài bẫy Song và đày anh ta trong một năm, trong thời gian đó người anh trai kém may mắn của anh ta bị sát hại và hỏa táng. Cuối cùng, khi Song trở về nhà, anh đưa vụ án ra tòa nhưng thẩm phán gạt nó sang một bên và đột ngột đóng lại. Liệu Song cuối cùng có thể trả thù cho cái chết của anh trai mình?

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: BÃO TỐ BANGKOK - BANGKOK STORM
programme.desc: Võ sĩ ngầm Lin Feng bị bộ ba Bangkok truy lùng khi từ chối đấu trong một trận đấu trái luật. Anh trốn thoát thành công nhưng bị mất trí nhớ. Trong khi Feng bắt đầu cuộc sống mới, hội tam hoàng tìm thấy anh và thuê một võ sĩ hàng đầu để đánh bại anh. Khi Feng đột nhiên lấy lại trí nhớ trong quá trình đó, anh thề sẽ tiêu diệt bộ ba.

programme.title: 10 ĐỐI 10 (MÙA 3) - 10 FIGHT 10 SEASON 3
programme.desc: Chương trình quy tụ các siêu sao, ca sĩ, võ sĩ, người mẫu và rapper Thái Lan vào sàn đấu quyền anh nổi tiếng. Phần 2 có trận đấu đầu tiên của nữ Thái Lan và Phần 3 có hai vận động viên giành huy chương vàng Thế vận hội cạnh tranh chức vô địch. Chương trình đấm bốc độc đáo này mang đến sự giải trí toàn diện, với các buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp, trang phục xa hoa và những trận chiến đẫm máu thực sự!

programme.title: ANH HÙNG THỜI LOẠN - YOUNG HEROES OF CHAOTIC TIMES
programme.desc: Câu chuyện này lấy bối cảnh ở Thượng Hải vào cuối triều đại nhà Thanh, kể về một chàng trai trẻ, Chen Zhen, người đã vươn lên trở thành anh hùng dân tộc sau khi chịu đựng gian khổ và vượt qua thử thách trong cuộc sống.

programme.title: GIAO KÈO BÉO BỞ - A GOOD DEAL
programme.desc: Bị bắt cóc bởi một cặp vợ chồng tuyệt vọng, doanh nhân Burks Hill buộc phải thực hiện một hành trình điên cuồng đến Los Angeles. Khi nguy hiểm ngày càng gia tăng, ba du khách phát hiện ra rằng mỗi người họ đều ẩn chứa những bí mật chết người. Những gì bắt đầu từ một vụ bắt cóc đơn giản đã biến thành một trò chơi chết chóc mà không ai có thể sống sót.

programme.title: QUYẾT ĐẤU LỤC NHĨ MỸ HẦU - THE MACAQUE MONKEY
programme.desc: Thế giới hỗn loạn sau khi cây sự sống bị đốt cháy. Tôn Ngộ Không quyết định quay về quá khứ để hồi sinh nó, nhưng thần lực của anh không ổn định sau khi mất chiếc vòng vàng, và anh phải tìm lại bản thân lúc trẻ để hợp sức tìm kiếm sức mạnh thời gian. Vì Khỉ Macaque sáu tai cũng muốn có sức mạnh của thời gian nên chúng đụng độ nhau trong một trận chiến khốc liệt…
